# Philipp Albrecht

> Leipzig-based artist studying at HGB Hochschule für Grafik und Buchkunst Leipzig, exploring material and spatial relations. Bachelor of Arts in Art History from Universität Leipzig.

## About

Philipp Albrecht is a German artist based in Leipzig. He is currently a student at HGB – Hochschule für Grafik und Buchkunst Leipzig (Academy of Fine Arts Leipzig), working with installation, media art, and sculpture. He holds a Bachelor of Arts in Art History from University of Leipzig.

## Exhibitions

- Inter(-)Views, HGB Galerie Leipzig, 19.05.–03.06.2026
  https://www.hgb-leipzig.de/hochschule/kalender/2892
